about_the_game:
Demo

The demo contains the first chapter of the game.

World

Enhanced: Vengeance unfolds centuries in the future, on a distant planet in a far-off solar system. Humanity has mastered space travel and established new colonies across the stars. Medical and technological advancements have made cybernetic limbs and enhancements not only possible, but practical and easy to install by specialists. This is where your story begins.

Try to find the people who tortured you, maimed you and left you for dead.

Choices have consequences

Navigate a world of morally complex characters, each driven by their own goals, secrets, and sins. Will you manipulate them, stand by them, or simply shoot them? Your choices will forge the path ahead.

Integrated weapons and abilities into your cybernetics

Install devastating weapons and cutting-edge abilities directly into your cybernetics. Launch rockets, unleash gouts of flame, or discharge arcs of lightning straight from your palms. Fly with jets built into your legs, blink across the battlefield in a flash, or spot lootable items with enhanced vision. In this world, your body isn’t just augmented—it is a weapon.

Features:

  • Friendly and hostile factions

  • Character statistics

  • Inventory and equipment

  • Vendors

  • Random and tiered loot drops

  • Dialog

  • Quests

  • Save the state of the game at any time

  • Varied locations to explore

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore

short_description: Enhanced: Vengeance is a single-player, story-rich, first-person RPG. Upgrade your body with cybernetics as you explore a dangerous new world. Meet intriguing characters, take on quests, blast your way through hostile encounters, uncover valuable gear, and level up to unlock your full potential.
